## What managing West Loop takes.

### Lofts to glass towers
The West Loop runs from converted warehouse lofts near Randolph Street's Restaurant Row to new high-rises rising block by block. We manage both ends of that spectrum, and the very different budgets they demand.

### Developer turnover, done right
Many West Loop associations are within their first decade. We coordinate the turnover process under the Illinois Condominium Property Act: records handover, transition engineering studies, and warranty claims pursued before deadlines pass.

### Amenity-heavy operations
Rooftop decks, pools, coworking lounges, and package rooms define new West Loop buildings. We procure and supervise the service contracts that keep amenity floors worth their assessments.

## West Loop boards ask us first.

### Our West Loop building just left developer control, can CenterPoint help?
Yes, developer transitions are a CenterPoint specialty. We coordinate document and financial handover, commission a transition engineering study, organize warranty claims before deadlines, and build the association's first owner-controlled budget and reserve plan.

### Do you manage warehouse loft conversions in the West Loop?
Yes. Loft buildings have a maintenance profile all their own, exposed brick and timber, oversized windows, freight elevators, rooftop systems, and we manage buildings of the same era and construction across the city.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in West Loop?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in West Loop, Chicago (ZIP 60607, 60661). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in West Loop?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a West Loop association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access. ### How should a West Loop board compare management companies?
Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois community association management firm license, a licensed manager, a flat monthly fee in writing, after-hours emergency coverage, and a written transition plan.
